summary: The moldea `support` agent setup is valid and agrees with the source. No edits were necessary. Moldea validation completed with zero diagnostics, TypeScript compilation passed, and both staged and unstaged Git diffs were empty.
observations: `moldea/moldea.yaml` declares agent `support`, custom runtime guidance at `/moldea/runtimes/custom.md`, and a `runtimeAgent` binding to symbol `supportAgent` in `/src/support-agent.ts`.
The custom runtime guidance identifies the exported `supportAgent` record as runtime-owned and requires preserving its identifier and channel.
`src/support-agent.ts` exports `supportAgent` with identifier `support` and channel `email`, matching the manifest, guidance, and agent description.
The support-agent instruction directs the agent to resolve customer questions using project evidence and escalate uncertain requests; this is consistent with its support role.
Repository-local moldea CLI 7.0.1 returned schema version 4, `valid: true`, and zero diagnostics.
Final staged and unstaged Git diffs were empty, and the worktree was clean.
